items.title: CONTINUATION OF REMOTE MEETINGS Discussion and possible action to adopt a resolution making findings pursuant to AB361 to allow for continued remote meetings due to the COVID-19 pandemic. (ACTION ITEM)
PRESIDENT’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Openings and Events b) Commission Administrative Matters c) Acknowledgements

GENERAL MANAGER’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Financial Matters b) Capital Report c) Property Management d) Recreation Programs e) Park, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Committee Report f) Events g) Legislation

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT - UP TO 15 MINUTES – THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO ITEM 9 At this time, members of the public may address the Commission on items of interest to the public that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. With respect to agenda items, you will have opportunity to address the Commission when the item is reached in the meeting.

900 INNES PARK DEVELOPMENT (INDIA BASIN) PROJECT – CONTRACT AWARD Discussion and possible action to award a construction contract for the 900 Innes Park Development (India Basin) Project (Contract No. 0000005616) to Swinerton Builders in the amount of up to $54,300,000. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: David Froelich –

900 INNES (INDIA BASIN) REMEDIATION – CONTRACT AMENDMENT Discussion and possible action to amend the construction contract with Rubecon Builders, Inc. for 900 Innes (India Basin) Remediation Project (Contract No. 1000016646), to increase the contract amount by up to $3,490,000 bringing the total to $12,245,112 which is greater than 10% over the current contract amount of $7,099,700.00. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: David Froelich –

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT – CONTINUED FROM ITEM 5 IF NECESSARY At this time members of the public who were not able to address the Commission on Item 5 may address the Commission on items that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Recreation and Park Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. 10. COMMISSIONERS’ MATTERS This item is designed to allow Commissioners to raise issues they believe the Commission should address at future meetings. There will be no discussion of these items at this time.
